name: Hive 1.5.6
notes: Definitive fix for @hive not answering on a local (relay-less) install. Root cause confirmed from the on-disk log: repeated local-identity changes leave the OLD self hoisted into the workspace roster as a second human member under a different account id, so the workspace looked multi-human and the primary deferred the turn to a stale self-identity that no live device owns — silent 'thinking…'. With no relay configured nothing ever syncs to another device, so this device now always answers regardless of the recorded owner (both the local send path and the sync path). Combined with 1.5.5's keyless Claude Code fallback, a fresh no-key install responds out of the box.
